text:
mira: Ok folks — we need to lock the integration contract and release gates for the LangChain / LlamaIndex connectors + gateway adapters. Goal: joint marketplace listing, docs, and a short demo by end-of-week Friday.

alex: what's the blocker right now? legal, engineering compatibility, or marketplace QA?

mira: combo. legal needs the SOW + data handling clause signed. eng needs a compatibility matrix, smoke tests, and a packaging artifact for the marketplace.

sam: I can own the announcement copy and press/partner comms. need confirmed feature list and the demo script to align messaging.

raj: I will own the adapter e2e and CI gating. propose release gates (minimal):
- Contract & SOW signed
- Compatibility matrix uploaded to partner repo
- E2E smoke tests passing in staging
- Docs + runbook (onboarding steps + known limits)
- Marketplace artifact (bundle + checksum)

alex: +1. can we automate the smoke via orchestrator infra? I'll add a workflow. quick snippet to run locally:
```
./scripts/run_smoke.sh --connector llamaindex --gateway v2
```

mira: perfect. @integrations-bot can you spin up a Jira ticket on partner board when the signed contract PDF lands? also tag legal.

integrations-bot: task created -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INTG-4321 :white_check_mark: (assigned to sam, raj)

sam: timeline check — legal said 48-72h to review SOW. engineering can parallelize the matrix + tests. proposed announce date: 2026-03-27.

raj: demo env is ready, just need model checksum + sample dataset. i'll DM the S3 path. also will post smoke results here once run.

alex: CI job added to repo: https://github.com/redwood/orchestrator/actions/runs/98765 — it runs the smoke and uploads a report to the ticket.

mira: owners: legal (sam), eng (alex), integrator (raj), comms (sam). next sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. :calendar: please bring the compatibility matrix PR and the draft runbook.

raj: noted. will post the first smoke run by EOD and link artifacts to INTG-4321.

sam: i'll draft the co-announcement headline and a short demo script: "Redwood + LangChain: enterprise-grade orchestration for connectors" — will share here for quick review.

mira: awesome — thanks all. reminder: attach the signed contract PDF to the Jira ticket and drop any marketplace packaging notes (bundle name, version, checksum).
